title: bee feature start leaves the lane mode as bee state start-feature leaves it
action: Found live on 2026-11-04: `bee feature start --class feature --lane small` wrote mode "feature" into the lane record, and the shape gate, which reads mode before route.lane, then demanded a plan.md for a small lane. After this cell the lane record `bee feature start` leaves has the same mode `bee state start-feature --as-lane` leaves with no --mode, so a small or tiny route passes the gate without a plan, and the existing test that pinned mode "feature" checks the corrected value. Red first. No code comments. One commit with the trailer `cell: asf-2`.

truths: bee feature start never writes the route class into the lane mode
a small route opened by bee feature start passes the merged gate with no plan.md
the lane record matches what bee state start-feature --as-lane leaves
key_links: a test fails before the change and passes after
prohibitions: Do not weaken an existing assertion beyond correcting the pinned mode value
